title: Advanced Conditionals
completion_message: ¡Brillante! Has dominado las estructuras condicionales más avanzadas del inglés. Usar Inversión Condicional y Mixed Conditionals te permite expresar arrepentimientos financieros y escenarios hipotéticos con una elegancia absoluta.

parts.visual:
En C2, dejamos de usar 'If' en escenarios muy formales, usando la 'Inversión Condicional'. 

1. Inversión del 3er Condicional (Pasado irreal): 
Normal: If I had known about the risk, I wouldn't have invested. 
Inversión: HAD I KNOWN about the risk, I wouldn't have invested. 
(Simplemente quitamos 'If' y ponemos 'Had' al principio). 

2. Inversión del 2do Condicional (Presente/Futuro irreal): 
Usamos 'Were' + sujeto + to + verbo base. 
Normal: If he resigned, the stock would crash. 
Inversión: WERE HE TO RESIGN, the stock would crash.
parts.audio: Welcome to Advanced Conditionals. In the C2 level, we often drop the word 'If' in highly formal contexts by using Conditional Inversion. Number 1: Inversion of the Third Conditional, which deals with unreal past events. Normal sentence: If I had known about the risk, I wouldn't have invested. Inversion: HAD I KNOWN about the risk, I wouldn't have invested. We just drop 'If' and put 'Had' at the beginning. Number 2: Inversion of the Second Conditional, for unreal present or future events. Normal: If he resigned, the stock would crash. Inversion: WERE HE TO RESIGN, the stock would crash. Notice we use 'Were' plus the subject plus 'to' and the base verb.

parts.visual:
3. Inversión del 1er Condicional (Posibilidad real futura): 
Usamos 'Should'. Significa 'Por si acaso' o 'En el improbable caso de que'. 
Normal: If you need further assistance, please contact me. 
Inversión: SHOULD YOU NEED further assistance, please contact me. 

4. Mixed Conditionals (Condicionales Mixtos): 
Mezclamos el 3er y 2do condicional cuando el pasado afecta al presente. 
Pasado -> Presente: 
If I HAD BOUGHT (pasado) Bitcoin in 2010, I WOULD BE (presente) a millionaire now. 
(No se dice 'would have been' porque sigues siendo millonario AHORA).
parts.audio: Number 3: Inversion of the First Conditional, for real future possibilities. We use 'Should', meaning 'just in case' or 'in the unlikely event that'. Normal: If you need further assistance, please contact me. Inversion: SHOULD YOU NEED further assistance, please contact me. Number 4: Mixed Conditionals. We mix the third and second conditionals when an unreal past event affects the present. For example: If I HAD BOUGHT Bitcoin in 2010, I WOULD BE a millionaire now. We use 'had bought' for the past, but 'would be' for the present, because the result is happening right now, not in the past.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma condicional avanzada correcta.

questions.question: Normal: If I had seen the email, I would have replied. -> Inversion: ____ the email, I would have replied.
questions.explanation: Inversión del 3er condicional: Had I seen = If I had seen.

questions.question: Normal: If you require more information, call this number. -> Inversion: ____ more information, call this number.
questions.explanation: Inversión del 1er condicional: Should you require = If you require.

questions.question: Normal: If the company failed, thousands would lose their jobs. -> Inversion: ____, thousands would lose their jobs.
questions.explanation: Inversión del 2do condicional: Were + sujeto + to + verbo.

questions.question: Mixed Conditional (Past condition -> Present result): If I ____ harder at university, I would have a better job now.
questions.explanation: Si yo HUBIERA estudiado (pasado perfecto) -> tendría (presente).

questions.question: Mixed Conditional: If he had taken my advice last year, he ____ in bankruptcy court right now.
questions.explanation: Consecuencia presente: él NO ESTARÍA (would not be) ahora.

questions.question: ____ you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact our legal team.
questions.explanation: Should you have = If you have (en caso de que tengas).

questions.question: ____ it not been for your help, the company would have gone bankrupt. (Si no hubiera sido por...)
questions.explanation: Had it not been for = Si no hubiera sido por.

questions.question: Mixed Conditional (Present condition -> Past result): If I ____ a more patient person, I wouldn't have shouted at the client yesterday.
questions.explanation: Condición permanente en el presente (If I were = Si yo fuera) afectando una acción pasada.

questions.question: ____ the board to reject the proposal, the CEO would resign immediately.
questions.explanation: Were the board to reject = If the board rejected.

questions.question: ____ we known about the impending crisis, we wouldn't have expanded into Europe.
questions.explanation: Had we known = If we had known.

questions.question: Mixed: If they hadn't lost that massive contract, they ____ firing people today.
questions.explanation: Consecuencia en el presente ('today'): wouldn't be (no estarían).

questions.question: ____ an emergency arise, press the red button to stop the machinery.
questions.explanation: Should an emergency arise = If an emergency arises.

questions.question: ____ I you, I would seriously reconsider signing that contract. (Si yo fuera tú).
questions.explanation: Were I you = If I were you (Condicional 2 invertido).

questions.question: ____ the negotiations failed, we would have lost millions. (Negativa invertida).
questions.explanation: Had the negotiations failed = If the negotiations had failed.

questions.question: Mixed: If I wasn't so terrified of flying, I ____ to London for the conference last week.
questions.explanation: Condición presente (miedo a volar) -> Resultado pasado (habría volado).

questions.question: But for the government bailout, the bank ____. (A no ser por... el banco habría colapsado).
questions.explanation: But for = If it hadn't been for. Consecuencia pasada: would have collapsed.

questions.question: ____ anyone call while I'm in the meeting, tell them I'll call back later.
questions.explanation: Should anyone call = Si alguien llamara (poco probable).

questions.question: ____ he to offer you a bribe, what would you do?
questions.explanation: Were he to offer = If he offered.

questions.question: Mixed: If she had signed the non-compete clause, she ____ working for our rival right now.
questions.explanation: Consecuencia presente ('right now'): she wouldn't be.

questions.question: ____ I realized how difficult this project was going to be, I would never have accepted it.
questions.explanation: Had I realized = If I had realized.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave de la Inversión Condicional (Had, Should, Were).

questions.question: ____ I known the truth, I wouldn't have gone.
questions.explanation: Had.

questions.question: ____ you need help, please call me.
questions.explanation: Should.

questions.question: ____ she to quit, we would be in trouble. (If she quit)
questions.explanation: Were.

questions.question: ____ it not been for your advice, I would have failed.
questions.explanation: Had.

questions.question: ____ anyone ask, tell them I am out.
questions.explanation: Should.

questions.question: If I had bought it, I ____ be rich now. (Mixed conditional)
questions.explanation: would.

questions.question: ____ I you, I would not accept the deal. (If I were you)
questions.explanation: Were.

questions.question: ____ we seen the error, we would have fixed it.
questions.explanation: Had.

questions.question: ____ the economy to crash, gold prices would rise.
questions.explanation: Were.

questions.question: ____ you require further details, see the attachment.
questions.explanation: Should.
